note: Viewpoints of the hero frames (design.md §12.1): where the camera stood, where it looked, its 35 mm equivalent focal length from EXIF, and the local clock (CEST: EXIF time + 1 h, design.md §3.1). x and north in metres (§6.1); 'agl' is the eye height above the ground there. heading in degrees clockwise from north, tilt in degrees (negative looks down). 'weather' fixes the clouds: seed, peak coverage, overcast, cirrus, and 'cloudAt', a ground point the densest cumulus cell is moved over. Authored by lining the render up with the photograph (open /?view=<id> in development and call praha.sheet() in the console).
